question.prompt: The probability of a miss on each shot is \(1/2\). What is the probability of misses on all 3 shots?

solutions.explanation:
Using the independence assumption supplied by the exercise heading, multiply the three miss probabilities:
\[
P(\text{three misses})=\left(\frac12\right)^3=\frac18.
\]
solutions.title: Product under the stated independence setting
